commands.name: unit
commands.command: TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit pnpm exec turbo run test --summarize --log-order=grouped --concurrency=2

commands.name: web-functional-e2e
commands.command: cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright test --project=functional --workers=2 --grep-invert "@destructive|@stateful"

commands.name: affected-coverage
commands.command: TURBO_TEST_MODE=coverage COVERAGE=true pnpm exec turbo run test:coverage --filter="...[51ec8da561789e51892c3288a64b733ed872d323]" --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped
